programme.desc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #9
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #10
programme.desc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島—一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #2
programme.desc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉。他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #3
programme.desc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房。然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮。他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #5
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感。他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士、溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #7
programme.desc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #8
programme.desc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #9
programme.desc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #2
programme.desc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉。徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #3
programme.desc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #5
programme.desc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東—孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一—雲南。 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化。

programme.desc: 波爾基烏斯試圖以尼貝利姆託付給他的強大力量控制周圍,將奧偍瑪蒂亞從緋紅的異空間救出來。但一名應該早就被打倒的男人,突然從奇美拉之中出現,擋住他的去路。在翼之血族走投無路時,卡姆想起了讓他嘗到敗仗的殺盡龍,基爾賽雅,那是個與他不分軒輊的強者。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #24
programme.desc: 拉格納和卡姆,追求絕對之力的兩者傾盡長久以來累積的實力激戰,這場在異次元中的戰鬥也終於迎來結局。於絕望中重拾操縱時間之力的奧偍瑪蒂亞,試圖回溯時間,找回所有失去的血族…

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #2
programme.desc: 阿久津被莉莉制服並成為了她的僕人,被迫協助她狩獵惡魔。阿久津拒絕協助,並表示他寧願被淨化也不願殺死自己的同類。於是莉莉便啟動了套在阿久津頸上的「奪走自由並施以懲罰的頸圈的力量」。然後,阿久津的身體就不由自主地開始動了起來……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #3
programme.desc: 阿久津帥氣地救出了在街上被搭訕的莉莉。儘管對遲到的阿久津感到生氣,兩人卻依舊直接前往約會……不,是前往狩獵惡魔。莉莉懷疑最近頻繁發生的野犬襲擊事件是惡魔的所為,於是她便和阿久津一同在街道中展開探索。然而,卻有一道殺氣騰騰的目光正注視著他們。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #1

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #2

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #1
programme.desc: 白石純太是存在感薄弱的少年,連同學和老師都察覺不到其存在,因此無法登上名為青春的大舞台。然而坐在他隔壁的同學・久保渚笑卻發現了白石的存在。有天久保好奇在大家眼中白石的存在感究竟有多低,於是向他搭話,還說他在上課時站起來或許也不會被發現。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #2
programme.desc: 白石期待地去買最愛的漫畫新刊,興致勃勃的他抵達書店後發現因為自己存在感薄弱,自動門竟然沒有反應,使他進不去!此時恰巧路過的久保成功替呆站在原地的他解圍。 久保對白石喜歡的漫畫感興趣,雖然決定向他借閱……。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #3
programme.desc: 阿久津帥氣地救出了在街上被搭訕的莉莉。儘管對遲到的阿久津感到生氣,兩人卻依舊直接前往約會……不,是前往狩獵惡魔。莉莉懷疑最近頻繁發生的野犬襲擊事件是惡魔的所為,於是她便和阿久津一同在街道中展開探索。然而,卻有一道殺氣騰騰的目光正注視著他們。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #4
programme.desc: 莉莉遇到了獸型惡魔,並與其展開了激烈的戰鬥。阿久津因夾在同族與莉莉之間而陷入兩難,他為了想辦法平息事態而介入了他們的戰鬥。然而,同族卻將阿久津視為叛徒,而莉莉則警告阿久津不要妨礙她,不然就將他給淨化。這時,被逼到絕境的阿久津思考出了一個辦法。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #13
programme.desc: 奎達工廠的事件發生在兩個星期前。蘇萊塔在學院裡,期待著再次見到米奧莉奈。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #17
programme.desc: 緹娜夏成功解除了奧斯卡的詛咒,並在大聖堂迎來鐸洱達爾女王的登基典禮,然而她卻在儀式中告知精靈們契約已經終結,並宣布她只會當女王一年。這都是為了讓鐸洱達爾成為不需依賴個人魔力的國家。而後被奧斯卡求婚的緹娜夏,因這意料外的發展而感到動搖。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #18
programme.desc: 鐸洱達爾發生導致孩童傷亡的崩塌事故,緹娜夏卻無法透過封印在寶物庫的魔法球回到過去。面對強國賽札魯對法爾薩斯的入侵,奧斯卡率軍迎擊,對方的士兵卻幾乎都是活死人。緹娜夏因為這禁忌的咒術而介入戰爭,她雖成功壓制住咒術的元兇,賽札魯的邪神希米拉…

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #19
programme.desc: 一直對法爾薩斯造成威脅的幕後黑手瓦爾托擄走了緹娜夏,要她協助取得紅色與藍色的魔法球「艾爾特利亞」。緹娜夏對湊齊魔法球的後果也不清楚。詛咒奧斯卡的沉默魔女菈碧妮亞在法爾薩斯城現身,揭開了自己是奧斯卡祖母的事實,以及他母親蘿莎莉亞死去的真相。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #20
programme.desc: 岡杜那國王的代理人奧蕾莉亞和她的監護人特拉畢斯來參加奧斯卡的慶生儀式。特拉畢斯為了避免衝著自己來的魔族費朵拉攻擊奧蕾莉亞,請緹娜夏當替身。法爾薩斯城內出現身分不明的棄嬰,當緹娜夏遭受費朵拉襲擊,裹著黑霧的嬰兒卻出現在奧斯卡和奧蕾莉亞面前!

programme.title: 海賊王 #10
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #4
programme.desc: 高木同學在寒冷天氣穿著夏季制服上學,只要讓高木同學說「好冷」就算她輸了…西片是否能讓高木同學說出「好冷」呢… 收錄「冬季制服」、「便當」、「幽浮」、「晚上」等五個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #5
programme.desc: 西片一早發現飯裡加了討厭的東西,變得情緒低落。後來西片試圖猜中高木同學討厭的東西,然而… 收錄「餃子」、「角色分配」、「釣魚」等四個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #6
programme.desc: 文化祭前一天,西片的班級決定表演話劇,在放學後留校練習,但西片卻遲遲沒有進步,變得無精打采的。最後留下來陪西片練習的高木同學邀他到屋頂…文化祭當天是否能夠順利演出呢?

programme.desc: 鐸洱達爾發生導致孩童傷亡的崩塌事故,緹娜夏卻無法透過封印在寶物庫的魔法球回到過去。面對強國賽札魯對法爾薩斯的入侵,奧斯卡率軍迎擊,對方的士兵卻幾乎都是活死人。緹娜夏因為這禁忌的咒術而介入戰爭,她雖成功壓制住咒術的元兇,賽札魯的邪神希米拉…

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #19
programme.desc: 一直對法爾薩斯造成威脅的幕後黑手瓦爾托擄走了緹娜夏,要她協助取得紅色與藍色的魔法球「艾爾特利亞」。緹娜夏對湊齊魔法球的後果也不清楚。詛咒奧斯卡的沉默魔女菈碧妮亞在法爾薩斯城現身,揭開了自己是奧斯卡祖母的事實,以及他母親蘿莎莉亞死去的真相。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #20
programme.desc: 岡杜那國王的代理人奧蕾莉亞和她的監護人特拉畢斯來參加奧斯卡的慶生儀式。特拉畢斯為了避免衝著自己來的魔族費朵拉攻擊奧蕾莉亞,請緹娜夏當替身。法爾薩斯城內出現身分不明的棄嬰,當緹娜夏遭受費朵拉襲擊,裹著黑霧的嬰兒卻出現在奧斯卡和奧蕾莉亞面前!

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #4
programme.desc: 高木同學在寒冷天氣穿著夏季制服上學,只要讓高木同學說「好冷」就算她輸了…西片是否能讓高木同學說出「好冷」呢… 收錄「冬季制服」、「便當」、「幽浮」、「晚上」等五個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #5
programme.desc: 西片一早發現飯裡加了討厭的東西,變得情緒低落。後來西片試圖猜中高木同學討厭的東西,然而… 收錄「餃子」、「角色分配」、「釣魚」等四個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #6
programme.desc: 文化祭前一天,西片的班級決定表演話劇,在放學後留校練習,但西片卻遲遲沒有進步,變得無精打采的。最後留下來陪西片練習的高木同學邀他到屋頂…文化祭當天是否能夠順利演出呢?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #3
programme.desc: 阿久津帥氣地救出了在街上被搭訕的莉莉。儘管對遲到的阿久津感到生氣,兩人卻依舊直接前往約會……不,是前往狩獵惡魔。莉莉懷疑最近頻繁發生的野犬襲擊事件是惡魔的所為,於是她便和阿久津一同在街道中展開探索。然而,卻有一道殺氣騰騰的目光正注視著他們。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #4
programme.desc: 莉莉遇到了獸型惡魔,並與其展開了激烈的戰鬥。阿久津因夾在同族與莉莉之間而陷入兩難,他為了想辦法平息事態而介入了他們的戰鬥。然而,同族卻將阿久津視為叛徒,而莉莉則警告阿久津不要妨礙她,不然就將他給淨化。這時,被逼到絕境的阿久津思考出了一個辦法。

programme.title: 海賊王 #10
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:克服現實不似預期的挑戰 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列
programme.desc: 華人福音工作是現今最大的禾場,我們需要怎樣的裝備,將福音的種子帶到華人當中?就讓擁有豐富牧會經驗的張路加牧師,教大家好好裝備,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 劉三論今-風風雨雨牽手情
programme.desc: 聖經上說:「人的怒氣,並不成就神的義」,你怎麼靠著神,在處理夫妻之間的矛盾中經歷得勝?創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 雙祥大整賀年食物-年糕及蘿蔔糕，一於祝節目收視步步高升，亦由此引申到圈中藝人平步青雲、步步高升的幸運例子。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 雙祥準備了豐富食材，為大家整大吉大利賀年盤菜，二人更分享拍攝群戲時鮮為人知的幕後趣事！

programme.title: 鼎爺做節攻略粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺以櫻花蝦、梅菜、五花腩、豆腐四種簡單食材炮製出宴客佳餚。留意鹹梅菜與甜梅菜的比例，切碎後以白鑊烘乾，然後與五花腩拌勻舖在豆腐上蒸熟，最後淋上泡油後的櫻花蝦是精粹所在！緊接鼎爺製作「黃金豆腐」，豆腐先浸在滷水中至入味，切粒後蘸脆漿炸香，配上XO醬同吃別有一番風味。以雞入饌可謂過節必備，鼎爺特以雞項製作「蔥油雞」。留意蒸雞方法，雞隻蒸好後斬件，接着淋上文火炸香的蔥油，蔥香配嫩滑雞肉味道一流！

programme.title: 2025香港小姐競選決賽粵
programme.desc: 張敬軒以美妙歌聲揭開本屆決賽序幕，十四位準港姐閃耀登場。佳麗才藝比拼，現代舞、古箏、花式跳繩、藝術體操、Rap唱夠驚艷；緊接配合李治廷的歌聲奉上繽紛Catwalk演出，並訴說夢想中的無限可能。十強佳麗晉身「海底世界」，在泳裝答問環節展口才和美態，再於衛蘭靚聲引領下漫遊「童話仙境」，還有鄺美雲獻聲助興。五強終極拉票，最終陳詠詩冠軍加冕，施宇琪、袁文靜分獲亞、季軍，李尹嫣則成「最上鏡小姐兼友誼小姐」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 大年初三，蘇民峰師傅繼續亮相節目，為屬鼠、屬牛、屬虎的觀眾帶來馬年生肖運程。預測涵蓋事業、愛情、健康等範疇，並提出建議錦囊，據說其中一個生肖在這年有機會財源滾滾！中式書法多以平面呈現，有藝術家嘗試將傳統書法立體化，希望做到一筆一劃皆可觀賞，既具美感又保留書意。藝術家到臨細談從陶泥、木材到鐵材的製字經歷，並展示以鐵材製成的字雕塑作品，分享創作心得。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨示範「日系山椒南瓜雞肉煮」。

programme.title: 一班好聲音「十」力無限演唱會粵
programme.desc: 十位「中一生」發放「火熱動感」，更無懼突破。李佳、羅啟豪、顏志恒、林鉫徫無伴奏打造<天梯；龍婷、支嚳儀韓風舞動<失憶周末。丁文俊、魏嘉信操肌特訓玩<脫掉；吳大強逆齡夥拍支支Rap唱<係咁先啦。周吉佩除挑戰拉丁舞，與志恒、嘉信跳唱<忘情森巴舞時，還獲各自愛妻伴舞。「中二四大天王」獻聲撐場，玩轉<廣播道Fans殺人事件。回望好聲音追夢之旅，中一生<不再猶豫，也對支持者呼喊<無言感激！

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 宵越一邊練習一邊摸索「勝利」的路徑，反而愈來愈焦躁，井浦見狀，便建議宵越發展自身優勢，成為最強突襲者。數天後，宵越跑步時意外撞倒一個完全沒有氣息的瘦弱男子，而此人的真實身份竟是……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 農曆新年期間，大家享用了不少高熱量的賀年美食，是時候跟隨「WORKOUT 2GETHER」鍛練，保持身體健康。基礎體適能訓練中，波比跳、原地跳等動作都需連續做出，玲玲姐姐完成後直言有點氣喘，但教練提醒，唯有達至這強度才可有效促進新陳代謝。接着還會利用阻力帶強化肌力，針對手臂、大腿、腹部進行鍛練，有甚麼相關動作？本集亦帶來AI生成動畫《年獸的故事》下半部，究竟留在村中的伯伯將如何對付兇猛的年獸？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 正當陽葵三人分享贏得美人魚大賽造型的喜悅之際，陽葵想到一個疑問，就是每次大賽的獎品，到底是由誰人挑選。根據四眼姐姐說法，這是「委員會」的工作。而委員會的成員，就是DJ荷特、史派西P與馬卡龍女士三人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新聞，明日歷史」。每天那麼多新聞，大家可能來不及消化，更遑論回望歷史。歷史就是一個大寶庫，少看歷史和小看歷史，很容易「走寶」。新節目《新聞掏寶》帶大家在寶庫「掏」新聞寶藏，除了昔日特輯、直播和系列報道，還有從未曝光的珍貴片段，觀眾有機會重溫李小龍出殯、寶生銀行劫案、四人幫審訊、英女王訪港、的士罷駛、中英簽訂聯合聲明、戴卓爾夫人專訪、越南難民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、啟德機場關閉、鄧小平逝世、九七回歸大典、華航香港空難和沙士記者會。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾從網店訂講的盆菜發出酸臭味更疑似有蟲，幸獲退款，但據悉該店現已失聯。天水圍區內不少單車遭到剪爛煞車線等各種程度的損毁，為踏車人士添危險，破壞者疑是同一人。男事主藉配對平台認識某女子，接下來的約會、外遊支出，都由事主付鈔，還要斥資款待隨女子同來的親友。事主為「交往」付出數萬元，卻連女方之手也沒牽過，自覺受騙成提款機！事主其後登門尋訪女子，得悉對方竟是現役女警……郭富城亮相賀歲馬活動，送上花絮。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2747粵
programme.desc: 過年前，樹根向街坊鄰里「挑起事端」，原來另有圖謀。因樹根之故，城安的利是收入大減，需要設法增加「進賬」。熊家的親戚大多移居海外，城安向三舅公越洋拜年，成功討得利是，卻令樹根大破慳囊。不少海外親戚欲向樹根越洋拜年，城安想到一個「低成本」派利是的解決方法，詎料……大四喜出埠表演，當地卻因某些原因禁止新年習俗。其後，城安致電樹根，稱海外一眾親戚親身前來要向樹根拜年，提醒樹根切勿回來……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#23粵PG
programme.desc: 希仁找到為妃宸進行人工受孕的生殖學家程國揆。國揆是趙舟的好友，提到自己早已認識希仁……妃宸懷疑人工受孕出錯是趙舟指使，希仁往找趙舟對質！善昱找龐喆，商量如何爭奪慶曆；子幀意外發現身世有可疑，向德敬問明真相。熊飛搜集趙舟陷害妃宸的證據，胚胎學家錢藝珠此時打算離港。逸桐發現義兄們往生殖醫學中心縱火，通知熊飛阻止，自己亦身陷險境……希仁試探國揆，國揆招認過錯，並說出令希仁震驚的真相！

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#15粵普
programme.desc: 沈家人發現韶光與林晏互生情愫，決意搬走。林晏問韶光為何躲著自己，韶光的違心話讓他黯然神傷。韶傑因牙人酷似前妻而被騙錢，因此大受刺激。曹融發現或有許多兵卒假死，趙荀之牽扯其中，林晏決定悄悄接近查探。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 年初三「赤口」，丞丞師傅帶展望、蒨文到訪肇慶悅城的龍母祖廟，並細述龍母的傳說故事。據稱摸龍母床可保祐生育，有何宜忌？風水玄學認為家居隱藏病位，楓燧師傅分享其檢測病位「法寶」及化解佈陣。玲玲師傅率眾遊逛深圳的花卉小鎮，細談買年花、養魚、擺放植物的心得，提醒忌於電腦旁放多肉盆栽？想添新年財，碧霞師傅推薦其「心水」旺財投注地區，以及幸運號碼與顏色。女士如想招桃花，雲文子師傅有其噴香水玄學見解，可供參考。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#5粵
programme.desc: 趙穆責連晉沒趁機殺少龍。應元見少龍蹴鞠的球技了得，請他訓練家將，廷芳及其兄廷威均不滿。廷芳叫連晉買藥教訓少龍，連晉卻買下毒藥給她。少龍夜探質子府遇陶方，少龍訛稱是秦相呂不韋派來的密探。少龍挑選精英以訓練蹴鞠為名，實則訓練拯救贏政的死士。廷芳在少龍的肉湯下藥，意外打翻，小狗舐吃後毒發身亡，廷芳質問連晉，連晉巧言脫罪。廷芳與廷威硬要加入蹴鞠訓練隊伍，少龍遂與廷芳打賭。廷芳入宮探望趙倩，大數少龍的不是。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#6粵
programme.desc: 廷芳完成考核，要少龍跳崖，少龍即縱身跳下，廷芳大驚。廷芳被少龍所騙，大罵他「衰人」。少龍以現代踢足球方法教眾人蹴鞠，廷芳與廷威表懷疑。比賽日，趙盤及王子趙嘉打賭。盤母趙雅令眾生傾倒，公子趙德嘲笑趙盤有名風騷娘親，趙盤憤怒。少龍等節節領先，連晉偷襲，少龍借口受傷出，與陶方趕往質子府救人遭埋伏，並赫見善柔。趙穆借問候少龍傷勢到烏家查探，幸少龍早有對策。廷芳偷聽少龍與應元等對話，驚悉秘密，對少龍改觀。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾從網店訂講的盆菜發出酸臭味更疑似有蟲，幸獲退款，但據悉該店現已失聯。天水圍區內不少單車遭到剪爛煞車線等各種程度的損毁，為踏車人士添危險，破壞者疑是同一人。男事主藉配對平台認識某女子，接下來的約會、外遊支出，都由事主付鈔，還要斥資款待隨女子同來的親友。事主為「交往」付出數萬元，卻連女方之手也沒牽過，自覺受騙成提款機！事主其後登門尋訪女子，得悉對方竟是現役女警……郭富城亮相賀歲馬活動，送上花絮。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 大年初三，蘇民峰師傅繼續亮相節目，為屬鼠、屬牛、屬虎的觀眾帶來馬年生肖運程。預測涵蓋事業、愛情、健康等範疇，並提出建議錦囊，據說其中一個生肖在這年有機會財源滾滾！中式書法多以平面呈現，有藝術家嘗試將傳統書法立體化，希望做到一筆一劃皆可觀賞，既具美感又保留書意。藝術家到臨細談從陶泥、木材到鐵材的製字經歷，並展示以鐵材製成的字雕塑作品，分享創作心得。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨示範「日系山椒南瓜雞肉煮」。

programme.title: 一班好聲音「十」力無限演唱會粵
programme.desc: 十位「中一生」發放「火熱動感」，更無懼突破。李佳、羅啟豪、顏志恒、林鉫徫無伴奏打造<天梯；龍婷、支嚳儀韓風舞動<失憶周末。丁文俊、魏嘉信操肌特訓玩<脫掉；吳大強逆齡夥拍支支Rap唱<係咁先啦。周吉佩除挑戰拉丁舞，與志恒、嘉信跳唱<忘情森巴舞時，還獲各自愛妻伴舞。「中二四大天王」獻聲撐場，玩轉<廣播道Fans殺人事件。回望好聲音追夢之旅，中一生<不再猶豫，也對支持者呼喊<無言感激！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 唔玩唔知身體好，唔測唔知時運高。陳嘉桓、連詩雅用求籤方式配對隊員後，進行連串「身體檢查遊戲」。氣球及石春路結合，證實連詩雅很久沒有夜蒲，亦看出張振朗、何浩文身體不濟。牙膏放在地上任踩，有人聲勢大卻得低分數，甚至有負分出現！張振朗跳群體竹舞時兩度連累隊友，還高呼錯不在他！罪魁禍首是甚麼？何君誠及何浩文頭戴VR眼鏡玩平衡木，當中有人極度畏高，甚至飆冷汗！出線一隊向許願樹拋橙，神明會否保佑他們收到禮物？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

鼎爺做節攻略粵
programme.desc: 豬油、雞油適合用來炮製不同食材，鼎爺起鑊製油，奉上兩道不一樣的滋味。「蟹粉肉絲炒年糕」的靈魂在於大閘蟹，揀選時有何貼士？豬肉眼扒口感嫩滑，加上甘香豐腴的蟹粉，味道層次進一步提升。上海年糕下鑊兜炒前，又要怎樣處理？刺身級西班牙紅蝦可以生吃，下鑊烹調亦不宜過熟。鼎爺煎香原隻紅蝦，再用蝦頭、蝦殼煮出香濃蝦汁。陳村粉先用XO醬調味，蒸熟後再淋上雞油、蝦汁，味道更香滑。阿譚「出手」享用紅蝦，吮出啖啖鮮味！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 蘇民峰談馬年生肖運程來到尾聲，蘇師傅提到屬兔者於2026遇上財運年，而且桃花亦厲害？屬龍人士縱然平穩，但也有三個吉星。屬蛇者去年犯太歲，待農曆四月後可望否極泰來，同時迎接霧水桃花。「笑一笑，世界更美妙」，愛笑瑜伽導師指出多笑對健康甚有作用，並帶領主持、學員一同示範愛笑瑜伽基本功，最好由「扮笑」開始？接着的動作還注入新年元素，配合賀年氣氛！「睇餸食飯」，Annie藉「金沙百花球」祝觀眾馬年金銀滿屋！

programme.title: 一條麻甩在廣州粵
programme.desc: 廣州，粵菜發源地之一，廣府菜的中心，是每一位食客都無法拒絕的美食聖地。愛吃愛玩的主持人麥包，在廣州徹底釋放了吃貨天性，走遍大街小巷，尋找地道美食：悠閑早茶、西關小吃、新潮佳饌，夜市小攤

programme.title: 單戀雙城#13粵
programme.desc: 式適求元山被趕，但恭梓解決了元山問題，助式適說服他再次帶團。Marco想找恭梓作曲。禛加入榴槤炮製雞蛋仔得錢進大讚，欲製作榴槤小圓餅參賽。專榮忘記結婚周年紀念，書舒發現丈夫的婚戒不見了，痛罵後趕走他。

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 王城向宵越訴說他的目標，就是與夥伴攜手勝出，成為日本第一的卡巴迪隊伍。他認為宵越亟需實戰經驗，於是火速安排了一場練習賽。對手是由王城舊友六弦歩領軍，兼且坐擁王牌高谷煉的關東四強，奏和高中。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 馬年初四，插畫師子健哥哥到來「Artspiration」，教大家用畫筆呈獻一隻活力十足的賀年小駿馬。波浪形鬃毛、躍起姿勢都是繪畫重點，還要為其「穿上」中式拜年新衣，再以幾項賀年裝飾作點綴，添上新春氣氛。炮仗可怎樣畫？適逢過年，一眾小朋友都有萬樣歡樂事想「開心Share」。有小朋友分享每年辦年貨的「策略」，主持們則聊起行花市的經歷。提到賀年糕點，大家又愛吃甚麼款式？另有小朋友帶來在內地放煙花的片段。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 阿櫻找上陽葵，查看偶像公主手環的情況。陽葵的手環是Priverse公司交託予學生會特別型號，現在卻只有陽葵能駕馭它，阿櫻一直都想解開這個謎團。在交談途中，阿櫻還說起了，學生會就是因為偶像公主手環而走在一起。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2748粵
programme.desc: 雷公向敢威追討欠款，並以敢威承諾償還債務的錄音為憑證，揚言採取法律行動。敢威起初對自己曾說過這些話毫無印象，力蓮等人徹查亦無所得，敢威後來才記起醉酒時與雷公打賭的經過。縱使敢威願意還錢，但雷公拒收，似乎另有目的。敢威遂找虹豆沙湯遠調停，沙湯遠提出特別方法嘗試解決紛爭，卻事與願違。其後，雷公「出招搞事」，令接龍聲譽受損，敢威只好設法應對。最終，敢威為平息風波，答應了雷公提出的要求……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#24粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)趙舟涉嫌買兇縱火被捕。熊飛翻查子禮出事地點，發現不妥……善昱公開子幀身世，欲奪慶曆主席之位。國揆約希仁到教堂見面，泰巨挾持善昱到來，希仁鏡反射泰巨的毒癮，不能自控……希仁自認殺害國揆，善昱亦指證他。善昱召開董事會，要求取消主席由嫡長子優先繼承的制度……頌星等人設法要說服希仁放棄認罪；眾人於教堂發現新線索……泰巨挾持善昱逃亡，熊飛展開追捕，險象環生！法庭上，頌星為希仁辯護……

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 支嚳儀開設的烘焙店已衝出香港，適宜向美加發展嗎？有請玲玲師傅賜教，師傅還提到其命盤有名氣運，連帶是非亦較多。丞丞師傅偕展望、蒨文往廣州的黃大仙祠參拜，並細說其歷史故事。俞可程2025年連環遇上不幸事，包括駕車發生意外，她載碧霞師傅重返現場，察看可有不妥……大大個卦象圖擺辦公室，想利事業恐惹上司討厭？勤龍師傅建議可用AI生成畫像，將上、下卦分別化為動物、自然景象。另有璞初師傅細談何謂「旗鼓八陣法」。

康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#7粵
programme.desc: 趙穆從連晉口中得知少龍好女色，心生一計。少龍在市集為趙雅制服癲馬後，覺事有蹊蹺。少龍送廷芳玉簪，廷芳暗喜，但當知趙雅約會少龍，憤而擲簪，少龍拾斷簪拂袖而去。趙雅對少龍百般挑逗，趙盤闖入指罵二人蕩婦淫賊，趙雅怒摑之。趙雅醉倒，對少龍沒有乘人之危深表欣賞；廷芳妒火中燒。少龍遭刺殺時善柔出現救他，少龍責她助紂為虐，善柔反斥他不知感恩。趙穆怒責連晉派人殺少龍全為了廷芳。少龍應趙雅之約往賞花，廷芳打翻醋酲。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#8粵
programme.desc: 趙穆以美人、大屋拉攏，少龍不為所動。廷芳無意中打破趙雅送給少龍的蘭花，向趙倩索新蘭花作賠償，趙倩透露將遠嫁韓或魏國。趙雅要趙盤拜少龍為師，趙盤不屑，少龍露一手令趙盤甘心拜師。陶方指著廷芳所送蘭花，暗示廷芳喜歡少龍，少龍苦惱。趙穆直指少龍是外國奸細，又指少龍的錦盒內藏通敵密函。少龍在趙雅府重遇趙倩，誤會她是小宮女。趙盤使用墨子劍法令趙德跪地求饒，引得神秘人注視。少龍被神秘人跟蹤，二人大打出手。

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 蘇民峰談馬年生肖運程來到尾聲，蘇師傅提到屬兔者於2026遇上財運年，而且桃花亦厲害？屬龍人士縱然平穩，但也有三個吉星。屬蛇者去年犯太歲，待農曆四月後可望否極泰來，同時迎接霧水桃花。「笑一笑，世界更美妙」，愛笑瑜伽導師指出多笑對健康甚有作用，並帶領主持、學員一同示範愛笑瑜伽基本功，最好由「扮笑」開始？接着的動作還注入新年元素，配合賀年氣氛！「睇餸食飯」，Annie藉「金沙百花球」祝觀眾馬年金銀滿屋！

programme.title: 鼎爺做節攻略粵
programme.desc: 豬油、雞油適合用來炮製不同食材，鼎爺起鑊製油，奉上兩道不一樣的滋味。「蟹粉肉絲炒年糕」的靈魂在於大閘蟹，揀選時有何貼士？豬肉眼扒口感嫩滑，加上甘香豐腴的蟹粉，味道層次進一步提升。上海年糕下鑊兜炒前，又要怎樣處理？刺身級西班牙紅蝦可以生吃，下鑊烹調亦不宜過熟。鼎爺煎香原隻紅蝦，再用蝦頭、蝦殼煮出香濃蝦汁。陳村粉先用XO醬調味，蒸熟後再淋上雞油、蝦汁，味道更香滑。阿譚「出手」享用紅蝦，吮出啖啖鮮味！

programme.title: 一條麻甩在廣州粵
programme.desc: 廣州，粵菜發源地之一，廣府菜的中心，是每一位食客都無法拒絕的美食聖地。愛吃愛玩的主持人麥包，在廣州徹底釋放了吃貨天性，走遍大街小巷，尋找地道美食：悠閑早茶、西關小吃、新潮佳饌，夜市小攤

programme.title: 單戀雙城#13粵
programme.desc: 式適求元山被趕，但恭梓解決了元山問題，助式適說服他再次帶團。Marco想找恭梓作曲。禛加入榴槤炮製雞蛋仔得錢進大讚，欲製作榴槤小圓餅參賽。專榮忘記結婚周年紀念，書舒發現丈夫的婚戒不見了，痛罵後趕走他。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 點心、茶、茶樓有何相關歇後語？鄭寶鴻細談昔日「飲茶」掌故，還講解「單料銅煲」、「混吉」的出處。主持們到訪刀具店、旗袍店與影樓，實地了解與刀、布、攝影器材等有關的歇後語。廖舜禧帶來「唔使問阿貴」的典故。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 主持在花墟測試街坊對植物、交通、金錢相關歇後語的認識；及後前往粥店與餅家，探索「亞茂整餅」等與美食有關歇後語。鄭寶鴻細說「陸榮庭睇相」出處。廖舜禧帶來「牛o趙牡丹」的「o趙」、「筍盤」的「筍」正寫。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 斯里蘭卡人的生活與鼓密不可分, 無論是節日慶典、宗教儀式、婚禮甚至喪禮都會打鼓本集將會介紹兩種斯里蘭卡的傳統鼓-蓋塔貝拉及班庫拉班的製作方法和匠人們的故事

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 天未亮，敏之帶高Ling、嘉欣、諾懿上山賞雲海，卻忘記查看天氣狀況，令眾人白行一趟……站在高處大聲呼喊，高Ling心中最想說甚麼？回到勞勿市中心，三位好姊妹前往懷舊茶室，享用地道早餐。補充活力之後，三姊妹深入榴槤園幫忙噴灑肥料，付出勞力換取即開即吃貓山王。用榴槤殼洗手，原來可去除手上殘餘的味道？園主親自下廚炮製「榴槤農家炒飯」，為食的高Ling還闖進廚房偷師。「榴槤燜巴丁河魚」又是怎樣的創意菜式？

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 疫情下無得飛，五位主持在本地玩盡「港產」新玩意。山系KOL鄭衍峰、曾淑雅出發挑戰高難度的香港三大險峰之一蚺蛇尖！面對越行越斜的山路，一步一驚心下終成功登頂。二人別開心得太早，落山才是終極考驗！歐陽偉豪(Ben Sir)、戴祖儀、淑雅實測深水埗美食團抵玩指數，一條龍食勻本地街頭小吃，細嚐貼地「茶記」文化，順道認識荳品美食的多變！嘉賓楊潮凱為林穎彤引路，發掘鯉魚門石礦場打卡聖地，留意拍攝女神風的技巧。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 2025年製作的戀愛真人秀節目《女神配對計劃》掀起熱潮，谷主凱婷覺得能引起觀眾共鳴與刺激感是關鍵。瀅仴提到韓國製作的同類型節目尺度更大，汛文卻持相反意見？汛文概略整理了此類節目的發展史，並與拍檔們嘗試分析成功原因，得出「花生友」的角色甚為重要！眾人又推敲參加者的報名動機，並指由於目的清晰，加上多方面的壓力，都讓參加者在節目中容易鎖定目標對象。不過，在這情況下誕生的戀情可會堅固，谷主們則有不同看法。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集的菜式是西洋菜豆腐羹，主持人教大家怎樣吃到幼嫩的西洋菜，而又不用浪費的方法，材料清洗乾淨後，先將部分耐煮的材料放進鍋子裡熬煮，待味道出來後再加入西洋菜及豆腐，煮沸後勾芡，就成為清爽又有飽腹感的菜式

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 洪永城與小朋友討論男女於性格、坐姿、拍照擺甫士的分別，男孩蔡施齊的看法卻不獲女生們認同？蕭雪瑤模仿男孩的動靜時，也有所避忌。永城讓關向晴、施齊、雪瑤按照說明書做STEM小手工，施齊自信地完成「重力橋」。轉用針線造髮夾，施齊亦變得細心，嘉賓STEM Sir提到或是源於男士「唔輸得」的天性？有女孩帶永城參觀自己的城堡主題房間時，滿心歡喜。但當看到多件與性別相關的物品被「斷捨離」，她隨即忍不住落淚！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴坐上E5隼號，成功擊破敵人。高輪邀請太晴加入超鐵機，但後者因為保護不到行人天橋而自責。高輪告訴太晴其姊伊奈也是超鐵機職員，更有跡象顯示她仍在生，太晴想起伊奈從前跟他說過的一番話語。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 透過左右跳、青蛙跳、登山者式等動作，可加強身體的爆發力。彤彤姐姐完成訓練後反映小腿特別酸軟，教練指這屬正常反應，並安排大家稍作休息，再展開《WORKOUT 2GETHER》的第二個訓練。在反應訓練中，大家不時要兩人一組進行。其中一人負責發號施令，另一人則即時完成動作。教練更提升難度，加入禁止動作的指令，考驗專注力與反應速度，大家又能否跟得上？「動物好萌友」環節，會介紹可愛的侏儒兔及其生活習性。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子想要香味橡皮擦，央求媽媽買給她，但媽媽要求她先把現有的橡皮擦用完，否則自己儲錢買。小丸子花光紅包錢，心情低落，得知有機會探望外公外婆，於是想盡辦法旁敲側擊，提醒對方派紅包。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 全球賽馬市場潛力巨大，世界各地的頂級賽事往往吸引數以萬計的旅客。本港在2024年《施政報告》及《旅遊業發展藍圖20》提出要發展賽馬旅遊，近年香港亦有多匹賽駒在世界舞台打出名堂，吸引國際馬迷注目，更有馬迷專門到日本探訪已退役的香港馬王，賽馬旅遊的經濟效益有多大？國際馬術盛典連續第二年在香港舉辦，正值「送蛇迎馬」之際，香港未來可以如何捉緊這些盛事帶來的機遇？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 不少武術高手於佛山出身，丞丞師傅走進北帝廟，講述它如何成為當地祖廟，同時亦欣賞舞獅表演，接財接福。廟內一個兩米高臺，有何厲害？學識如何攝太歲，遇上犯太歲之年也可稍為安心，齊齊跟玲玲師傅了解相關程序。人人皆適宜新年行大運，玲玲師傅建議犯太歲者尤其需要，要往哪個方向走？哪三個生肖於馬年桃花運最旺？許文軒跟大隊聽碧霞師傅指引。雲文子師傅從奇門遁甲談面相玄機；法銘師傅則帶來掛電子揮春的注意事項。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！《聲夢傳奇2》亞軍兼小提琴家黃洛妍、大學主修音樂的應屆港姐「最上鏡小姐及友誼小姐」李尹嫣，分別接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: 馮允謙、陳柏宇「一晚限定」合唱<今日，席間允謙談到為其他歌手度身訂造寫歌的「漫長」程序，他還帶來自家新作<齊柏林飛船。Plan V的<Fat Fat Fat Choy將嘻哈風格融入賀年歌，適宜年初五即席獻唱！黃淑蔓輕快唱出<喵！這首新歌，訴說貓奴對主子的觀感。柏宇的新歌<旁若無人有多難唱？聽他現場演繹或可略知一二。談及即將舉行紅館演唱會，柏宇卻稱屆時不會有驚喜，反而主持人為他帶來了驚喜！

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 武術名將李暉退役後積極推動太極與培育後進，旗下武術中心亦已進駐啟德。早前眾年輕騎手夥拍可愛嬌小的雪特蘭小馬展開競技，為國際馬術盛典帶來活力；還有亞洲青年挑戰賽戰報。「小劍神」計劃舉辦劍擊賽事，助基層學員向精英運動員道路進發。學界籃球精英賽，拔萃男書院與協恩中學分別衛冕男、女子組冠軍。中環海濱慈善跑連結愛心，藉跑步做善事。初三發財跑在山頂舉行，跑友齊賀新春。港超聯高級組銀牌決賽，流浪與大埔爭奪錦標。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#1粵PG
programme.desc: 雙胞胎晨與曦，自小姐妹情深，父母離異後，晨隨母去新加坡定居，曦則隨父留在香港。長大成為特警的晨在一次突擊行動中竟發現曦的屍體，為查明真相，晨以曦的身分展開調查，並跟蹤前來新加坡調查工程師失蹤之事的杰。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 疫情下無得飛，五位主持在本地玩盡「港產」新玩意。山系KOL鄭衍峰、曾淑雅出發挑戰高難度的香港三大險峰之一蚺蛇尖！面對越行越斜的山路，一步一驚心下終成功登頂。二人別開心得太早，落山才是終極考驗！歐陽偉豪(Ben Sir)、戴祖儀、淑雅實測深水埗美食團抵玩指數，一條龍食勻本地街頭小吃，細嚐貼地「茶記」文化，順道認識荳品美食的多變！嘉賓楊潮凱為林穎彤引路，發掘鯉魚門石礦場打卡聖地，留意拍攝女神風的技巧。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 2025年製作的戀愛真人秀節目《女神配對計劃》掀起熱潮，谷主凱婷覺得能引起觀眾共鳴與刺激感是關鍵。瀅仴提到韓國製作的同類型節目尺度更大，汛文卻持相反意見？汛文概略整理了此類節目的發展史，並與拍檔們嘗試分析成功原因，得出「花生友」的角色甚為重要！眾人又推敲參加者的報名動機，並指由於目的清晰，加上多方面的壓力，都讓參加者在節目中容易鎖定目標對象。不過，在這情況下誕生的戀情可會堅固，谷主們則有不同看法。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 天未亮，敏之帶高Ling、嘉欣、諾懿上山賞雲海，卻忘記查看天氣狀況，令眾人白行一趟……站在高處大聲呼喊，高Ling心中最想說甚麼？回到勞勿市中心，三位好姊妹前往懷舊茶室，享用地道早餐。補充活力之後，三姊妹深入榴槤園幫忙噴灑肥料，付出勞力換取即開即吃貓山王。用榴槤殼洗手，原來可去除手上殘餘的味道？園主親自下廚炮製「榴槤農家炒飯」，為食的高Ling還闖進廚房偷師。「榴槤燜巴丁河魚」又是怎樣的創意菜式？

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 洪永城與小朋友討論男女於性格、坐姿、拍照擺甫士的分別，男孩蔡施齊的看法卻不獲女生們認同？蕭雪瑤模仿男孩的動靜時，也有所避忌。永城讓關向晴、施齊、雪瑤按照說明書做STEM小手工，施齊自信地完成「重力橋」。轉用針線造髮夾，施齊亦變得細心，嘉賓STEM Sir提到或是源於男士「唔輸得」的天性？有女孩帶永城參觀自己的城堡主題房間時，滿心歡喜。但當看到多件與性別相關的物品被「斷捨離」，她隨即忍不住落淚！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 斯里蘭卡人的生活與鼓密不可分, 無論是節日慶典、宗教儀式、婚禮甚至喪禮都會打鼓本集將會介紹兩種斯里蘭卡的傳統鼓-蓋塔貝拉及班庫拉班的製作方法和匠人們的故事

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S1
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 好搭檔(完)

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 向風而行(完)
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful(完)
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: Crack In the World
programme.desc: Dr. Steven Sorenson (Andrews) plans to tap the geothermal energy of the Earth's interior by means of a thermonuclear device detonated deep within the Earth. This experiment causes a crack to form and grow within the earth's crust, which threatens to split the earth in two if it is not stopped in time.

programme.desc: On August 24, 1939, at a small French cafe, six friends are about to go their separate ways. They vow to reunite on that day each year at the cafe. On the day Paris is liberated, the three surviving friends meet at the cafe and get drunk.

programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth

In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.desc: Glitch's bath time puts the creatures of Puerto Rico's Bioluminescent Bay in bubble-trouble.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Blue Mountains, Jamaica
programme.desc: Trouble brews in Jamaica when Glitch's campfire threatens a coffee plantation.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Jigokudani Monkey Park, Japan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters fly to the rescue in Japan, as Glitch gets up to his usual monkey business.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S1) - Larry's Chinese Tofu, Egg and Prawn
programme.desc: Larry is cooking steamed tofu, egg and prawn. China is famous for its wonderful food so Larry's friends are very excited to come over for his Chinese themed meal.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Painted Dog Pups
programme.desc: Globetrotting Andy, Jen and Scout are on a new mission in their Eco-Explorer: to discover more about incredible animal families and their babies.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S8) - The Big Brain Swash Challenge
programme.desc: In this episode the pirates impress Captain Captain when they start doing a perfectly pirating puzzly puzzle!

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Sold!
programme.desc: When the toy shop closes, Krash falls down and gets stuck by a red label with Sold! on it.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Mount Mumandad
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Kids
programme.desc: A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingo's her baby and for Dad however, he is a very naughty boy.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Chickenrat
programme.desc: It's bedtime and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy. Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead their Mum through their bizarre day in the hope of tracking her down.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it's not Evil Pea after all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Roly needs a wee, but the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nu's elder sister hopes to restore the clan's honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the "walls"?

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yang's employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancee suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancee accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Nightmare of Darkness
programme.desc: A young actress’ Weibo account is refreshed with a new post three years after her death, disclosing her dating picture with young idol Wu Zi Zhen. Wu seeks help from the PR consultant Qiao Shen at his haunted house, but encounters a series of horrifying incidents. After being interrogated by Qiao, Wu lowers his guard and unveils a shocking secret...

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Deep in the Sea
programme.desc: Suspended psychiatrist Huang is asked to treat Zhao who suffers from schizophrenia. Zhao can only release himself from the pain of his girlfriend's death by killing people in his delusion. During the treatment, Huang is gradually affected by Zhao. He soon finds the way to cure Zhao, but then discovers an important secret about himself.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father’s underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau’s economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The English Opening

The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R &amp; D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling "Adult Babies" before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Poompf!
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits frames Boss and Tina’s startup company for exploding baby Iggy’s favorite stuffed animal, and Tina is forced to the sidelines to avoid any more bad press. As Crispin expands his plan to burst all the plush toys in the neighborhood, Tina discovers she can stop this by breaking open and rewiring a single toy doll. Unfortunately that doll is Baby Corp’s current head honcho, Pull-String CEO Baby.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Tchau, Uggos
programme.desc: Our team battles Rafaela’s mind-controlled crowd. They soon discover that Rafaela’s true plan is to steal the spy plane. Tony deduces that Rafaela isn’t doing all of this for the money - she’s doing it for family.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Giant Haboob

While Tony is grappling with his identity crisis, Echo struggles to survive spy school, and Ms. Nowhere and Gary disappear in a massive North African storm during their hunt for Cleve. Echo must lead the Toretto crew and finish Ms.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Dead End
programme.desc: The team travels to Nihaya, or "The Dead End," in their pursuit of Nowhere’s mission. programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - We Meat Again

However, three shops on the same street have resulted in destructive competition. Lung Kau (Mayanne Mak), Fok Siu-yuk (Ashley Chu) and Kam Chi (Kamen Kong) are their wives respectively. They often quarrel as they earnestly defend their husbands.

Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.
